Name: Survival Island
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
back with another farm map yay

it's a small island — ideal for a challenge run or a cute little compact farm that's focused on fishing. see how well you can utilise the limited space

* replaces [b]fishing farm 
[/b]* includes new farm cave (optional) with a spa for energy regen
* all grass is tillable/plantable

* click on the rowboats to travel to the smaller islands
* click the book on the table to see player stats

requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]smapi[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher﻿[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]daisyniko's tilesheets[/url]
